prompt: A clean technical isometric cutaway illustration, technical drawing style, axonometric projection. An asymmetric off-centre composition showing a robotic lawn mower chassis on a gridded terrain map, with a large outer theoretical boundary wire and a much smaller highlighted inner usable cutting zone. Constructed from matte grey and olive green polymer blocks and brushed steel rails, resting on a weathered concrete driveway. Flat muted palette with a single bright ochre accent highlighting the small usable area. Thin consistent line weight, visible depth to the hardware modules and terrain grid, one directional light casting long shadows, generous empty margin. No text, no letters.
